title: Preventing Trap Seal Evaporation
description: Drain traps rely on standing water to create a continuous liquid seal that blocks harmful sewer gas from entering occupied spaces. In infrequently used fixtures like mechanical room floor drains, normal ambient evaporation can lower the water level below the dip of the trap, breaking the seal. A key professional practice is installing a dedicated trap seal primer or an approved barrier device on vulnerable floor drains. Trap primers automatically add small amounts of clean water to the trap during nearby fixture usage, ensuring the water seal remains intact and effective over time.
